title: Load and manage per-user categories under Favorites after login (frontend)

requirements.summary: After successful login and backend connectivity, load categories and render them under the Favorites control with clear error handling on connectivity failure.
acceptanceCriteria: After login completes and backend connectivity succeeds, the UI shows the user’s categories under the Favorites control without requiring a manual refresh.
If the backend returns categories, the categories list in the UI matches the backend list (including after a full page reload).
If backend connectivity fails, the UI displays an error state and does not misleadingly show an empty categories list as if no categories exist.

file_operations.description: Pass backend connectivity/loading/error state (from usePromptLibrarySync/useBackendActorStatus) into the category UI so it can render an explicit 'unable to load categories' state under Favorites when connectivity fails. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Render categories directly below the Favorites control, and add a visible inline error/blocked state under Favorites when backend connectivity is in error (instead of silently showing no categories). Use shadcn-ui primitives already in use (Button/Badge/ScrollArea/Dialog/Input/Label) to keep styling consistent. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Ensure initial data load sets categories into the store only after connectivity succeeds, and keep connectivityStatus/connectivityError surfaced for UI error states (no UI changes here).

requirements.summary: Add an always-available Create category control directly below Favorites and persist new categories to the backend for the current user with duplicate prevention messaging.
acceptanceCriteria: The category UI includes a clear create-category control placed directly below Favorites.
Creating a category updates the UI immediately and persists the new category to the backend; after logout/login it still appears.
Attempting to create a duplicate category (case-insensitive) is prevented with a user-facing message in English.

file_operations.description: Add a 'Create category' entry directly below Favorites (input + action) that invokes a provided create handler; keep it visible even when there are zero categories. Use shadcn-ui Input/Button to match existing UI patterns, and disable or show guidance when backend is not ready. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire the new create-category control: implement an onCreateCategory handler that (1) prevents case-insensitive duplicates with an English toast message, (2) calls usePromptLibrarySync().saveCategory for backend persistence, (3) surfaces success/failure to the user in English, and (4) keeps UI state consistent with the category store. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Align category persistence calls with the backend interface: represent categories by name strings (no synthetic id), and call saveCategory/deleteCategory using the backend’s expected parameters so created categories persist correctly for the signed-in user.

requirements.summary: Ensure create/rename/delete category actions from the UI consistently use backend-synced actions and reflect success/failure to the user.
acceptanceCriteria: Create/rename/delete category actions from the category UI trigger backend calls and reflect success/failure to the user in English.
After any category mutation, the categories shown below Favorites remain consistent with the backend response (including after refreshFromBackend).

file_operations.description: Standardize category mutation wrappers (save/rename/delete) to return clear errors for UI messaging, and keep local stores updated only on successful backend writes to preserve backend-as-source-of-truth behavior.

Add duplicate-prevention and user-facing English messaging for rename (case-insensitive conflicts), and ensure rename/delete failures are clearly communicated (leveraging existing toasts from sync hook where applicable). Use existing shadcn-ui dialog/input/button components. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

When creating a new category from the prompt editor flow, call the backend-backed saveCategory action (via usePromptLibrarySync) instead of only mutating the local store; preserve existing case-insensitive duplicate prevention and add an English message when a duplicate is attempted. Use existing shadcn-ui Input/Button/Checkbox/ScrollArea components. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
